text:
maria: Hey folks — assembling an IKEA bookcase tonight. Looking for either a short (25–35 min) playlist that keeps me energized or a single 30-ish minute movie/TV episode to watch while I hammer things together. Bonus points for songs with good screw-driver rhythms or shows that don’t require full attention. :hammer_and_wrench: 
ben: I made a 30-min ‘power-tools & power-pop’ playlist last year. Open to share — mostly upbeat 2010s indie bangers. dropbox.com/shelf-playlist (quick link) :guitar:
kai: If you want ambient but peppy, try Tycho + Gold Panda mixed with a few upbeat tracks. Keeps you focused without yelling at you.
jess: For TV: 1 episode of The Great British Bake Off is perfect — calming, short, zero surprises, and you can half-watch. :tea:
omar: Or watch a single episode of Black Mirror: Bandersnatch if you want to feel like your bookshelf choices matter. joking. :grimacing:
sam: Short movie rec: ‘Before Sunrise’ is a lil slow but very watchable while doing repetitive tasks. ~100 mins tho so maybe not great.
maria: Love the Bake Off rec. Ben — can you paste the playlist in thread? Don’t want to open random links on my phone while balancing planks.
ben: Sure — putting tracklist here:`
1. Phoenix — Lisztomania
2. CHVRCHES — Recover
3. Vampire Weekend — Cousins
4. Lorde — Tennis Court (Aroha Remix)
5. Tame Impala — The Less I Know The Better
6. Sylvan Esso — Coffee
7. Foster The People — Houdini
8. Jungle — Busy Earnin'`
ben: Also added 2 mellow tracks at the end if you want to unwind.
spotify-bot: maria added Ben's playlist to their queue. :musical_note: (song preview available)
jess: If you want a TV episode with built-in tension but short: try a 30-min episode of Barry (S2 has some tight ones) — funny and keeps you moving.
kai: For audiobook / background listening: a short sci-fi short story collection — Isaac Asimov’s pieces read aloud are great for half-focused attention.
omar: Meme vote: which soundtrack while assembling? 1) Disco Donna Summer 2) Ambient Tycho 3) Punk 90s 4) Baking show music. React with :one: :two: :three: :four:
maria: Voting :two: and :four: (can't decide)
sam: If anyone else is assembling stuff tonight — bring extra Allen keys. They disappear into the couch like socks. :sweat_smile:
ben: True. Also pro tip: do loose-fit first, full-tighten at the end. Saves accidental re-drills. 
jess: Photo request: please send a before/after. if it's a disaster we will meme it mercilessly. :camera_with_flash:
maria: Will post pics. ETA 45 mins. Thanks everyone — playlist saved and Bake Off queued. :heart: 
ben: Good luck! :raised_hands: 
omar: If you end up needing motivation mid-assembly, DM me — I’ll send a playlist of Swedish pop + motivational GIFs.
maria: Last update: halfway done, one shelf slightly tilted but nothing a level can’t fix. sending victory pic in 10. :tada:
